tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.lv_dis: A 10-block treated wood pole for LV lines: three pin insulators on its crossarm (A, B, C) and the neutral (N) on a bracket below it. Hang a Pole-Mount Transformer on it for split phase.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.mv_sub: A 15-block treated wood pole for MV lines: three porcelain post insulators (A, B, C) on two crossarms, and a shield wire peak on top.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.hv_h_f: A 21-block H-frame of two treated wood poles for HV lines: three glass suspension strings (A, B, C) hung from its crossbeam.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.ev_lat: A 32-block galvanized steel lattice tower for EV lines: two circuits, each three glass suspension strings (A, B, C) hung from its crossarms.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.pin_in: One insulator, one conductor's end. Mount it on any face of a block to move FE between the block and the grid. All the pin insulators on one block make one port, which needs a whole circuit: A, B and C, or a line and N. Wrench: Configure sets the mode, Sneak + Configure the current limit, Rotate the phase, Port the circuit type.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.wire_c: One conductor. Use it on an insulator, then on another of the same tier, to string a wire between them. Sneak-use in the air lets go of the loose end. Keep a wire under its rated current, or it burns out.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.pole_t: Hang it on the side of a pole. Takes three-phase LV in on its lid (A, B, C) and gives split phase out on its front (L1, N, L2), the neutral carrying only the difference.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.burnt_: What's left of a wire that carried more than its rating for too long.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.wire_c: Use them on a wire to cut it, or on an insulator to cut every wire on it. The wire's coil drops where it was cut.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.creati: Creative only. Gives the grid FE through the pin insulators mounted on it. Wrench on Configure raises its FE/t (sneaking: lowers it).
Creative only. Takes FE from the grid through the pin insulators mounted on it. Wrench on Configure raises its FE/t (sneaking: lowers it).
